---
name: coherence-gate
description: Check Autor Ventura academic or evidence-heavy content for alignment between question objective method evidence results discussion and conclusion. Use when finalizing work where conclusions must be bounded by a documented method or evidence chain. Do not use when the piece is creative and has no analytical argument structure.
---

# Coherence gate

- Identify the governing question purpose or claim first.
- Map each objective to the method or evidence used to address it.
- Check that reported results are supported by the stated method and available data.
- Check that discussion interprets rather than invents results.
- Reduce conclusions that exceed the evidence.
- Flag missing limitations samples approvals or sources instead of fabricating them.
- Run the relevant academic or editorial evals after changing gate behavior.
